name: Diana Taurasi
known_for: WNBA all-time leading scorer with 10,646 points. Mercury career 2004-2024. Three titles (2007, 2009, 2014). 11 All-Star teams. The Hall page does not print a category word.

name: Sandy Brondello
known_for: WNBA titles as Mercury head coach in 2014 and Liberty head coach in 2024. Coach of the Year in 2014. First head coach of the Toronto Tempo (2025).

name: Mike Thibault
known_for: Connecticut Sun head coach 2003-2012. Washington Mystics head coach 2013-2022. Mystics' first WNBA title in 2019. Retired as the wins leader at 379-289.

name: Dee Kantner
known_for: Officiated 26 NCAA Women's Final Fours, including 16 national championship games. One of the first two women hired as NBA referees, with Violet Palmer.

name: Molly Bolin Kazmer
known_for: First player signed in the Women's Professional Basketball League (1978). WBL scoring champion at 32.8 points per game in 1980. Co-MVP with Ann Meyers that year. WBL single-game record of 55 points.

name: Judith Holland
known_for: First full-time director of women's athletics at UCLA, 1975-1980. Secured Ann Meyers' full scholarship, the first awarded to a woman at UCLA. USA TODAY calls her a contributor. The Hall page does not print that word.
